coverage.disclaimer: Country availability can change as partners update licensing, sanctions lists, and product coverage. Kura displays partner-published lists for transparency — final eligibility is always confirmed during in-app KYC.

seo.title: Stock Trading Countries (Dinari)
seo.description: See which countries support tokenized US stock trading via Dinari in Kura, and which regions are restricted.
seo.keywords: Dinari countries, US stock trading, dShares availability, Kura stocks

stockCountries.title: Stock Trading Countries
stockCountries.subtitle: Tokenized US stocks and ETFs via Dinari are available in 85+ jurisdictions outside the United States. This page lists regions where trading is not supported.

notAvailable.title: Not available
notAvailable.description: These jurisdictions cannot access Dinari stock trading through Kura at this time.

restricted.title: Restricted countries
restricted.description: Dinari cannot support business activities in these countries due to OFAC, FATF, and other regulatory requirements.

stockCountries.summary: Dinari dShares (tokenized US stocks & ETFs) are available to non-U.S. persons in 85+ jurisdictions. U.S. persons and residents cannot purchase or redeem dShares through Kura.

notAvailableNotes.United States: dShares are not registered under the U.S. Securities Act and may not be offered or sold to U.S. persons.
notAvailableNotes.Canada: Dinari is in the process of securing proper licensing to operate in Canada.

notes: All Dinari users must complete KYC before trading tokenized US stocks and ETFs.
Availability outside restricted countries does not guarantee every security or order type is offered in your jurisdiction.

mxnBrlCop.title: MXN, BRL & COP on/off-ramp (SPEI, Pix, Bre-B)

card.title: Debit/Credit Card (MoonPay)
card.description: Countries where MoonPay supports debit and credit card purchases for crypto on-ramp in Kura.

bridgeUnavailable.title: Not available for Bridge onboarding
bridgeUnavailable.description: Bridge services are unavailable for individuals and businesses located in these countries.

moonpayUnavailable.title: Not available for MoonPay card purchases
moonpayUnavailable.description: MoonPay debit and credit card on-ramp is unavailable for residents of these countries.

prohibited.title: Prohibited jurisdictions
prohibited.description: Bridge will not facilitate services for these jurisdictions under any rail.

notes: Kura on/off-ramps support USD, EUR, GBP, MXN, BRL, and COP via Bridge.xyz. Additional endorsements may be required for non-USD fiat rails after KYC.
Debit and credit card crypto purchases in Kura are powered by MoonPay. Availability may vary by card issuer, asset, and local regulations.
United States: Bridge supports most states except New York based on principal residential or operating address. Business eligibility has additional rules — see Bridge documentation.
United States: MoonPay card purchases are unavailable for residents of the U.S. Virgin Islands. Sell (off-ramp) has additional state restrictions — see MoonPay documentation.
USDT and Bridge-issued stablecoins are not supported for users in the European Economic Area (EEA) due to regulatory restrictions.
Inclusion on these lists does not guarantee every payment method or currency is available for your specific customer profile.
